sections.name: 食事？デザート？意外な組み合わせ

notes: Page 1 has two headings: 'パフェ オススメ5 / Parfait Recommend' (top) and an English-only 'KARAFUNEYA'S TIRAMISU PARFAIT' band (bottom; sub-labels Strawberry/Chocolate/Matcha per item).

'パフェ PARFAIT' is printed only once, at the top of page 2; pages 3-8 have no headings of their own (just the SET DRINK box), so all items on pages 2-8 are assigned to it. Pages are visually grouped by flavor (p3 chocolate, p4 strawberry, p5 berry/mango/pudding, p6 matcha/wa, p7 tea/coffee/peach, p8 caramel) but no flavor headings are printed.
Items in パフェ オススメ5 also appear on the パフェ pages: 324,377 (p2), 40 (p4), 533 (p6), 121 (p7); they are listed in both. Tiramisu items 509/403/404 appear only on page 1.
Page 8 bottom block 56,47,329 is headed '食事？デザート？意外な組み合わせ' (a tagline-style heading); they are listed under both it and パフェ.
Non-section labels ignored: 'ソフトクリームをたっぷり使用!!' (p2 tagline over the jumbo soft parfaits), '人気商品' badge on 377, 'ぜんざいに見立てたユニークなパフェ' caption on 306.
